G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import re,json,os
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=0]
    sepc={g[sep_rows[0]][0]} if sep_rows else set()
    # left column block color per band
    bands_r=[(a,b) for a,b in zip([0]+[r+1 for r in sep_rows],[r-1 for r in sep_rows]+[H-1])]
    bands_c=[(a,b) for a,b in zip([0]+[c+1 for c in sep_cols],[c-1 for c in sep_cols]+[W-1])]
    bandcolor={}
    for bi,(r0,r1) in enumerate(bands_r):
        col=0
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in range(0, bands_c[0][1]+1):
                if g[i][j]!=0: col=g[i][j]
        bandcolor[bi]=col
    # template: nonzero cells not of any bandcolor and not separator
    bcols=set(bandcolor.values())
    tmpl=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W)
          if g[i][j]!=0 and g[i][j] not in bcols and i not in sep_rows and j not in sep_cols]
    if not tmpl: return g
    rs=[i for i,_ in tmpl]; cs=[j for _,j in tmpl]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    shape=[[(1 if g[i][j]!=0 else 0) for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in sep_rows: out[i]=[g[i][0]]*W
    for j in sep_cols:
        for i in range(H): out[i][j]=g[0][j]
    for bi,(br0,br1) in enumerate(bands_r):
        col=bandcolor[bi]
        for (bc0,bc1) in bands_c:
            for si,row in enumerate(shape):
                for sj,v in enumerate(row):
                    if v: out[br0+si][bc0+sj]=col
    return out

print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
out=transform(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
